scope: Commit-32 Linear padding, fused bias ordering and logits-width consumers

issue_context.summary: A conversion shape error near lm_head was followed by the commit author's diagnosis that logits were not padded correctly for an odd-sized vocabulary and an intention to fix it shortly; another user reported a similar Phi-3-mini failure.
issue_context.link_limit: The commit does not cite the issue. Same author, phrasing, 128 dimension and timing make the relationship a strong inference, not a reference.

fused_bias_ordering.source_rule: In the fkey/frange load_fp16 branch, weight is sliced then padded, but bias from key + '.bias' is padded then sliced with frange.
fused_bias_ordering.effect_by_source: For a first fused sub-layer the post-padding slice can remove padding and leave bias shorter than the padded weight; later ranges can fall partly or wholly outside the per-layer bias.
fused_bias_ordering.reach_limit: Reach requires a per-layer bias tensor to exist for a fused layer. No model with that layout was established and no tensor operation was executed.

logits_widths.linear_head: The default pad_to=128 makes the head output width a multiple of 128 and forward does not trim it.
logits_widths.sampler: custom.py masks logits columns from tokenizer.actual_vocab_size onward to negative infinity when a tokenizer is supplied; without that mask padded zero-weight, zero-or-absent-bias columns yield zero logits.
logits_widths.return_logits: generator.py computes padded_vocab_size to a multiple of 32 and job.py sizes held_logits with it.
logits_widths.inconsistency: A vocabulary divisible by 32 but not 128 produces different head-output and held-logits widths after this commit.
logits_widths.reach_limit: SeqTensor.append behavior for mismatched widths was not traced, so runtime effect on return_logits is unassessed.

non_head_projection.source_rule: All Linear constructions inherit pad_to=128, including o_proj, down, up and gate projections.
non_head_projection.effect_by_source: A hidden or intermediate size not divisible by 128 makes those projections emit wider tensors than the residual or paired stream expects.
non_head_projection.execution_limit: No model with such dimensions was established and no forward pass ran.

limits: Source inspection only; repository tensor, generation and conversion paths were not executed.
The fused-bias and 32-versus-128 runtime effects remain conditional or unassessed.
Issue 8 is context by inference, not an explicit commit reference.
